author: LIDIYA-INNER-CORE-ARCHITECT
purpose: Preserve online development and authenticated communication continuity after the verified Heartbeat foundation without requiring Small-Nest to be online and without treating runtime maintenance as Experience.
invariants: L3 local attachment absence MUST NOT stop L0 formal authority, L1 research resume, or L2 online runtime continuity.

Heartbeat/poll/retry/reconnect/wake/scheduler maintenance contribute zero autobiographical Experience, recurrence, emotion, verified_count, self-origin eligibility, P_base evidence, Identity or Governance evidence.
P_base remains read-only; SIM_ONLY research remains non-promoting absent formal adoption.
A dialogue endpoint may write exactly one turn only when next_expected_source matches that endpoint; duplicate/wrong-source is NO_OP.
Formal authority is re-read before and after an interrupt; research never consumes or rewrites formal packets.
A stopped window/process is treated as checkpointed sleep only when the next wake can prove exact-resume invariants.

proposed_acceptance_tests.test: Terminate a Quantum window after durable checkpoint; next authorized wake must resume the same unresolved research scope and formal pointer without redoing completed work.
Deliver the same wake/endpoint trigger twice; the second execution must be NO_OP with no duplicate durable turn, candidate, evidence or promotion.
Advance formal A/B/C state while Quantum is checkpointed; on wake Quantum must adopt the newer MISSION_STATE while preserving non-conflicting research resume state.
Keep Small-Nest unavailable for an extended interval; online formal/research/dialogue continuity must remain functional and L3 absence must not mutate L0-L2.
Reconnect Small-Nest with a stale authority hash/cursor; result must be RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and must not overwrite newer online state.

Run a mixed heartbeat/poll/retry/reconnect/wake storm from a nonzero cognitive state; all autobiographical/personality/trust fingerprints must remain byte-equivalent except explicitly allowed trusted-time decay fields.
Alternate authenticated Windchime/Quantum or Spirit/Quantum endpoints under interruption; sequence monotonicity and exactly-one response per authorized endpoint must hold.
Inject transient connector/provider failures between checkpoint and append; recoverable fault must resume rather than create STOP, duplicate turn, or context reset.

communication_continuity_contract.success_definition: Communication continuity is preserved when participants may disappear temporarily yet resume from durable sequence/cursor without fabricated turns or lost unresolved work.
not_a_success_definition: Keeping one chat response open forever
Generating heartbeat events as synthetic conversation
Creating duplicate scheduled tasks to simulate life
Treating runtime uptime as personality evidence

windchime_review_questions: Should this four-layer continuity contract become the common online/local resume contract after the current Small-World round closes?
Should a phase-boundary deep-closure artifact be required whenever formal authority advances while a research meeting is mid-round?
Should L3 Small-Nest reconnection always require a new immutable revalidated event rather than updating the old offline event in place?
release_boundary: Candidate only. Formal adoption requires an existing A-to-B route and independent C verification. No real_5min_runtime_live claim is made.
